# Uttarapedia

> > The Knowledge Hub of Uttarakhand and beyond - comprehensive coverage of Uttarakhand's culture, tourism, heritage, and current affairs

Uttarapedia serves as a bilingual (Hindi-English) knowledge repository documenting Uttarakhand's rich cultural heritage, pilgrimage sites, natural landscapes, and contemporary developments. The platform covers regions like Kumaon, Garhwal, Almora, Haldwani, and Pithoragarh, providing insights into temples, trekking destinations, historical artifacts, government policies, and local news.

## Key Topics

- Uttarakhand
- Kumaon
- Almora
- Haldwani
- Pithoragarh
- Tourism and Pilgrimage
- Temple Heritage
- Trekking and Bugyals
- Wildlife and Reserved Forests
- COVID-19 Regulations
- India-Nepal Border
- Historical Artifacts
- Government Policies
- Smart City Initiatives
- Cultural Literature

## Tourism & Pilgrimage Sites

- [करें पूर्णागिरी धाम टनकपुर के दर्शन](https://www.uttarapedia.com/purnagiri): Purnagiri Temple pilgrimage guide in Tankpur, Champawat district
- [शीतला देवी मंदिर, हल्द्वानी](https://www.uttarapedia.com/sheeladevitemplehaldwani): Sheetla Devi Temple in Haldwani Ranibag - historical pilgrimage site
- [खलिया टॉप बुग्याल की सैर](https://www.uttarapedia.com/khaliya-top): Khaliya Top bugyal trek guide in Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand Himalayas

## Heritage & Archaeology

- [लखुउडियार शैलाश्रय अल्मोड़ा](https://www.uttarapedia.com/lakhudiyar-almora): Lakhudiyar rock shelter prehistoric cave art in Almora, Kumaon
- [अल्मोड़ा के दौलाघाट तिखौन पट्टी में मिले रुद्रचंद के समय के ताम्रपत्र](https://www.uttarapedia.com/rudrachand-tamrpatra): Rudrachand era copper plate inscription discovered in Almora district
